description: This file contains the code-behind logic for the StartExam ASP.NET page in an online examination system. It manages user session validation, populates course dropdowns based on user semester, handles navigation, and initiates different types of exams (theory or MCQ) by interacting with a SQL database. It also includes event handlers for user actions like selecting exams and checking if exams have already been taken.

classes.name: StartExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the StartExam ASP.NET page, handling page events and user actions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; checks user session, determines the user's semester, and populates course dropdown based on semester.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: startB_Click
methods.description: Initiates the selected exam after verifying exam availability and sets session variables accordingly.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of a theory exam from the grid, checks if already taken, and starts the exam if not.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of an MCQ exam from the grid, checks if already taken, and starts the exam if not.
